summary: [[character:howard]] crosses into the [[location:omicron2-eridani]] system ahead of the two colony ships, whose Bobs have named themselves [[character:bert]] and [[character:ernie]], and with their arrival [[species:human|humanity]] no longer has all its eggs in one basket. He parks at the L4 point between [[location:vulcan]] and [[location:romulus]], drops a beacon and sends drones to extend [[character:milo]]'s survey of both planets. He finds that the automation Milo left behind has spent a couple of decades stockpiling refined metal in orbit inside the asteroid belt, and that the farming donut [[character:riker]] had an [[technology:ami]] start a decade earlier only needs seeding. After checking in briefly with [[character:bill]] and Riker, who sends a list of colony ships already on their way, he welcomes [[vessel:exodus-1]] and [[vessel:exodus-2]] into orbit and meets Bert and Ernie, in Battlestar Galactica uniforms, in [[technology:vr]], where a joke about Vulcan cruisers gets a belly laugh. Wanting the colonists offloaded quickly and the ships sent back to [[location:earth]], Howard has the survey material passed to [[character:george-butterworth|Colonel Butterworth]] when he comes out of stasis. Butterworth chooses Vulcan, whose biocompatible ecosystem can bridge the gap until the colony grows its own food, and hopes to help the Spits when they arrive. With the farm not yet producing, most colonists stay in stasis while ship stores cover the first month; setup crews land printers, roamers build housing, and the first civilians are due to be woken in two days.

introducing.name: Bert
introducing.current_state: One of the two Bobs who crew the first colony ships, he has brought his ship into orbit at [[location:omicron2-eridani]] and keeps a virtual bulletin board of the colony's setup work. He is to fly back to [[location:earth]] once the colonists are offloaded.

introducing.name: Ernie
introducing.current_state: One of the two Bobs crewing the first colony ships, he has brought his ship into orbit at [[location:omicron2-eridani]], prepared survey material for the colony choice, and will fly back to [[location:earth]] once the colonists are offloaded.

introducing.name: Arrival of the first colony ships at Omicron2 Eridani
introducing.description: The arrival of the first two [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia]] colony ships, [[vessel:exodus-1]] and [[vessel:exodus-2]], at [[location:omicron2-eridani]] after a voyage of a little over eighteen years under [[character:howard]]'s escort, which began the first human colony beyond the [[location:solar-system]], so that [[species:human|humanity]] no longer had all its eggs in one basket. [[character:george-butterworth|Colonel Butterworth]] chose [[location:vulcan]] over [[location:romulus]] for its robust, biocompatible ecosystem, which could feed the colonists until their own food production was established. Setup crews landed printers and began building housing while most of the colonists remained in stasis.

updates.current_state: Stationed at the L4 point between [[location:vulcan]] and [[location:romulus]], he supports the founding of the Vulcan colony and wants the colonists offloaded quickly so that [[character:bert]] and [[character:ernie]] can head back to [[location:earth]].

Arrived at [[location:omicron2-eridani]] aboard [[vessel:exodus-1]], he has chosen [[location:vulcan]] for the colony and is more relaxed, though the food margin is tighter than he likes; he hopes to help the Spits when they arrive.

In orbit at [[location:omicron2-eridani]] since September 2188 and on station-keeping, it is supporting the colony setup on [[location:vulcan]] while most of its colonists remain in stasis. Once they are offloaded it is to fly back to [[location:earth]].

[[vessel:exodus-1]] and [[vessel:exodus-2]] reached [[location:omicron2-eridani]] in September 2188 and will return to [[location:earth]] after offloading, starting a shuttle service that may last a couple of centuries; more ships have already left [[location:sol]].

updates.state: [[character:milo]]'s automation has mined the system for a couple of decades, and an AMI-built farming donut awaits seeding as a backup food source. The first colony ships arrived in September 2188, and a colony is being set up on [[location:vulcan]].
updates.description: A triple-star system whose B and C stars orbit each other and whose pair orbits [[location:omicron-eridani-a]] at about 470 AU. Its survey identifies several outer Jovian planets, a probable asteroid belt, and the double planets [[location:vulcan]] and [[location:romulus]]. Vulcan is the site of [[species:human|humanity]]'s first colony beyond the [[location:solar-system]], founded with the [[event:first-colony-ships-arrival|arrival of the first colony ships]] in 2188.

updates.state: Several hundred thousand tons of ready-to-use refined material, bundled as beaconed ingots by [[character:milo]]'s [[technology:autofactory]] drones, is stockpiled in orbit inside the belt.

updates.description: The larger member of a double planet at 0.81 AU from [[location:omicron-eridani-a]] in the [[location:omicron2-eridani]] system, also designated OE-1A, with about 0.9 [[location:earth]] masses, orbiting [[location:romulus]] every 20 days. On the cool side of the habitable zone but warmed by a thicker, carbon-dioxide-rich atmosphere, it has oceans, oxygen and large green land areas, with animals nearly as large as dinosaurs and life probably related to Romulus's. Its ecosystem is confirmed to be biocompatible with [[species:human|humans]]. The [[event:first-colony-ships-arrival|arrival of the first colony ships]] in 2188 makes it the site of the first human colony beyond the [[location:solar-system]].
updates.state: Chosen in September 2188 as the site of the first colony from the colony ships, it has setup crews, roamers and AMI-controlled ground equipment building modular housing on the surface, and the first civilians are about to be woken and brought down.

updates.description: Kudzu gardens, informally called donuts, are unpopulated farming space stations proposed by [[character:homer]] to feed [[location:earth]]'s starving survivors. Each is a simple spoked wheel facing the sun, spun just enough for up and down, with mirrors lighting one interior cavern. They grow a gene-engineered, human-digestible kudzu bred for calories and are built with Homer's printers at the cost of future colony ships. The first, Farm-1, supplies raw kudzu to Earth's survivors; later designs can grow mixed crops. One was started by an [[technology:ami]] at [[location:omicron2-eridani]] as a backup food source for the colonists.
